title: Reorganize the locomotion packages by experiment and concern
summary: We renamed gait_clock to omniwalk and behavior_cloning to tripod, and we split the shared tools into evaluation and spark. Each omni concern now has its own module: IsaacEnv is the omni task's one Direct environment class, and OmniEnv is the surface that the MuJoCo surrogate shares. The physics identity changed, so native standing admission and the 13-probe parity check remain pending.
next: Run fresh native standing admission and the 13-probe parity of the unchanged c48_long checkpoint on Spark, then request full PR review.
reason: The refactor moves and splits locomotion modules and updates the guides. It adds no motion result and changes no gate; native admission of the changed physics identity stays pending.
